name: io.github.Menal226/nekoweb-mcp-server
title: Nekoweb
description: Manage your Nekoweb site: edit, upload and deploy files, check stats, and follow other sites.

environmentVariables.name: NEKOWEB_LOCAL_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional folder that limits which local files the upload tools may read

environmentVariables.name: NEKOWEB_SESSION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional nekoweb.org login cookie ('token') for features the API lacks, like site tags, stats history, followers and your feed
